messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] MethylKit latest manual ?
parts:
the latest manual is in the github page and is installed when the package is installed

within R, type:
help(package=methylKit)

Hello all,

I am using methylKit_0.9.4 and, just like any R package I am interested in using,  I looked up the user guide online. For methylKit, I found this nice manual : http://www.biomedcentral.com/content/supplementary/gb-2012-13-10-R87-S2.???

This user guide does not mention the function normalizeCoverage().Now, I am wondering if this manual is out of date or incomplete.. Could someone point me to a more complete user guide I might have missed ?

Thanks!
